pos.personaBrief: Rangnick wants extremely pronounced pressing and forward-only transitions with no square or back passes (Sporf 1998, ESPN 2020, Ballverliebt Hoffenheim), so possession is a tool, not a goal, and he does not hand the ball over to counter.

pro.personaBrief: Hoffenheim drills allowed two or three touches, flat only, forward passes after turnovers, and he did not accept square or back passes; vertical play was instilled by Peters (Ballverliebt, ESPN).

est.personaBrief: Strong basic order and defined roles with pressing triggers, but also rotating wide forwards and compact, close-together combinations in narrow drills (Sporf, Ballverliebt, Left Back Football).

lar.personaBrief: Teams used the 4-2-2-2 with two number 10s and two strikers, narrow compact shape, and wide play mostly through combinations rather than traditional wingers (Goal.com, Tifo, Left Back Football).

blo.personaBrief: Pressing and counter-pressing are the core of his model: forwards cut passing lanes from the first pass, 'a bit of pressing is like being a bit pregnant', three seconds of disorder after losing the ball.

mar.personaBrief: He championed the flat back four with ball-oriented zonal marking against sweepers and man marking in Germany (taz, ZDF Sportstudio, Ballverliebt), though Leipzig pressing was man-orientated in the press.

pla.personaBrief: He arrives with a fixed model and recruits players to fit it, playing the same pressing way against everyone, with only small tweaks such as the Ribery side adjustment (Ballverliebt, Coaches' Voice).

res.personaBrief: He pursues an aggressive, ambitious style and wants the scalp even against Bayern, plays to win away, and values how football is played, while ending games by pressing rather than parking.

sis.personaBrief: The system is everything: pressing for all, rules enforced for everyone, ordinary young players raised to a higher level inside the model (Hoffenheim, Leipzig, wheel of punishment).

jog.personaBrief: He wants fast, fit, strong, cognitively quick, intense players for hunting in packs; the classic slow number 10 does not fit, though technical quality on the ball still matters for a defensive midfielder.

bas.personaBrief: Hoffenheim and Leipzig were built with very young signings (average age 22.2, aged 24 or younger), not necessarily from his own academy, and he prefers young talent with growth potential over veterans.

lid.personaBrief: A demanding coach with many rules and punishments for lateness (wheel, dropped squad players), strong authority over methods, though he built trust with staff and clearly wanted buy-in.
